name: DataForSEO

env_keys.comment: Comparison only; anysearch does not read a key for this provider.

mode.comment: Delivery/priority options, not a unified SDK search quality mode. Queued and live rates differ.

notes: Comparison only; no anysearch SDK adapter is claimed.

requires_key.comment: HTTP Basic authentication with API login/password; credentials are required, although not a bearer API key.

snippet.comment: Organic items expose description as the search-result description.

domains.comment: keyword accepts site: operators; provider documents a 5x task charge for advanced operators. This is query syntax, not include/exclude domain arrays.

country.comment: location_code or location_name select search geography; country locations are documented.

language.comment: language_code or language_name select search engine language; lr is explicitly stripped.

date.comment: search_param forwards supported Google tbs time filters; this is engine date filtering, not guaranteed publication metadata. as_qdr is explicitly stripped.

safe_search.comment: Supported search_param safe=active filters explicit results; engine-specific parameter behavior, not a unified safe_search enum.

answer.comment: Advanced response can contain search-engine ai_overview/answer_box; not an always-generated DataForSEO answer. Async overview retrieval is separately charged.

content.comment: This SERP contract returns result elements and descriptions; the HTML variant returns search-engine SERP HTML, not full text from linked result pages.

summary.comment: Organic result description is an engine snippet; the complete organic item schema has no generated per-result page-summary output. Separate AI Summary products are outside this column.

highlights.comment: highlighted contains bold terms within engine results, not an independently generated excerpt/highlights service.

news.comment: Dedicated Google News SERP endpoint documented. Separate news request/engine variant, no anysearch adapter.

native_api.value: Depth, operators and extras alter cost; queued jobs are not comparable to Live latency.

rate_limits.value: $50 minimum prepaid; no subscription/expiry; Standard average ~5min, target 45min

checked_at.comment: Official public documentation reviewed; no paid API or benchmark run.

capability_basis.comment: SDK availability is separate from native provider capability. Each native feature cell carries its own checked date and evidence.

sdk_support.comment: SDK adapter availability only. See Capability basis for the feature rows; native features do not imply an SDK adapter.

pricing_per_1k.value: Standard queue $0.60; Priority $1.20; Live $2 / 1K SERP pages (≤10 organic results/page)
pricing_per_1k.comment: Units and commitments differ; do not rank these as equivalent flat per-query prices.

primary_price.basis: ≤10 results/page; queued, not Live; $50 prepaid minimum

lowest_price.basis: Standard queue is the cheapest tier; priority $1.20 and live $2 / 1K

free_tier_limits.comment: Trial, monthly credits and model-tool promotions are distinct.
